description: Continue the same free check through deep collection using 3–5 candidate theme IDs and verified competitor IDs from its latest snapshot. Preserve the requested brand and market. Select clear matches directly; ask the user only when intent is ambiguous. Never invent theme IDs or snapshot versions. If a requested competitor is absent from the snapshot, supply its name and website or public social profile in competitors with a custom: ID for verification. Supplied confidence and evidence do not establish verification. Read progress and the released report with socialseal_get_visibility_check.
